method: Observed before baseline values come from flow.json agent metrics for the fixed primary sample. Projected-after values are a planning model based on candidate fallback policies, not measured production runtime.

beforeBaseline.findingDetectionRisk: baseline preserved by full AI fallback
beforeBaseline.docsQualityRisk: baseline full finalize-sync docs path observed

projectedAfterModel.findingDetectionRisk: no increase accepted unless full AI fallback preserves blocking findings
projectedAfterModel.docsQualityRisk: deferred AI docs requires warning/follow-up artifact
projectedAfterModel.issueLogImpact: grouped findings reduce duplicate entries without deleting originals
projectedAfterModel.acceptanceLoopImpact: suggestedDisposition evidence may reduce repeated acceptance loops
